sermon.title: God With Us - June 25, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Saul was anointed and had God with him, but he rejected God’s word and the Spirit departed. David had no crown or throne, yet God was with him, and when he inquired of the Lord he prevailed. Jesus promises to be with us always—make Him a priority and don’t exchange His presence for anything.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What does the congregation do?
faqs.answer: Lay hands on the person next to them and pray.

faqs.question: Whom did God touch after he turned?
How long will the message be?
faqs.answer: He’ll try to keep it short.

faqs.question: What roles did David have?
faqs.answer: Saul’s armor bearer and harp player, then captain.

faqs.question: What did Saul exchange God for?
faqs.answer: His armor, army, crown and position.

faqs.question: Were David’s men well equipped?
faqs.answer: Only so equipped out in the wilderness.

faqs.question: How many men were with David at Ziklag?
What do we need?
faqs.answer: Parents with convictions who teach their kids right.
